title: Adžić undergoes surgery as Juventus loanee’s Sassuolo season may be over
snippet: Vasilije Adžić has undergone knee surgery, and the Juventus loanee could miss the rest of...
body: ITALY - OCTOBER 24: Martin Baturina of Como 1907 competes for the ball with Vasilije Adzic of US Sassuolo during the Serie A match between Como 1907 and US Sassuolo at Giuseppe Sinigaglia Stadium on October 24, 2026 in Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images) Vasilije Adžić has undergone knee surgery, and the Juventus loanee could miss the rest of the season with Sassuolo. According to a statement from Juventus , the 20-year-old Montenegro international suffered a sprain and bruising to his right knee in Montenegro’s Nations League game against Cyprus on 15 November. Tests revealed “a small osteochondral detachment”, meaning a piece of bone and cartilage had come away inside the joint. Adžić had surgery on Thursday at the Hôpital Privé Jean Mermoz in Lyon, where Juventus captain Manuel Locatelli was also operated on in September. He has now started the rehabilitation programme “aimed at returning to competitive activity”. Neither Juventus nor Sassuolo have given a timeframe for his recovery. However, TuttoMercatoWeb suggests the need for surgery points to a lengthy absence, with a real risk he won’t play again before the end of the 2026-27 season. It’s a cruel blow for a player who started his loan in style. Adžić scored in three consecutive Serie A games in September, including a curling winner off the bench in Sassuolo’s 3-2 victory over Juventus . His form has tailed off since then, and he has three goals and one assist in nine league appearances. REGGIO NELL’EMILIA, I
summary_en: Adžić had knee surgery for an osteochondral detachment and may miss the remainder of the season.

title: Spurs' Savio to miss festive fixtures after injury setback
snippet: Tottenham winger Savio will miss the club's Christmas fixtures with injury and could be out for up to 80 days, manager Roberto de Zerbi confirms.
body: Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Savio has not scored for Spurs since netting on his debut in August Tottenham winger Savio will miss the club's Christmas fixtures with injury and could be out for up to 80 days, manager Roberto de Zerbi has confirmed. Savio joined Spurs from Manchester City for £75m this summer, but has played in just five of their 11 Premier League matches this season. The 22-year-old came on as a substitute in the 64th minute of Tottenham 's 2-0 win over Ipswich on Saturday, but was forced off with two minutes remaining with a hamstring injury. It was the attacker's first game back in six weeks after returning from a muscle problem which led to him missing the four previous league matches. Asked if Savio, previously known as Savinho, would miss the Christmas schedule, De Zerbi said: "Yes, I think so unfortunately. "It is a tough situation to accept. He is a good guy. He is suffering for this new injury but it is part of football." "If you see the other European clubs, all of them, they are suffering many, many injuries." Savio is still searching for his first league goal or assist for Tottenham , although he did score and assist a goal on his debut in August in a 5-1 win over Charlton in the Carabao Cup. "Now, he needs time and hard work with the medical staff," De Zerbi added. "Then in 50, 60 or 80 days - I don't know when he comes back - he'll be crucial for us for the last step of the season." summary_en: Savio hurt his hamstring against Ipswich and could be out up to 80 days.
